2010 Presidential Election: Data Preparation

Source: vignettes/election-2010.Rmd
election-2010.Rmd

Preparation scope

This article documents the changes implemented for the 2010 presidential election. It preserves the exact capitalisation of the labels used in that script. Replacement values and source findings have not been independently verified for this documentation.

No additional correction recorded

The correction section explicitly states, “Nothing needs to be done.” It contains no count replacement, missing-value conversion, label correction, or percentage calculation specific to 2010.

Export and documentation limits

The absence of a correction in this script describes the preparation performed; it does not independently establish that the underlying dataset contains no errors. No dedicated 2010 reconciliation chunk is provided in the correction section.
